resources.string: Enter a recipe name up to 250 characters.
Set how many portions this recipe makes.
Enter a number of servings above 0.
Choose a food, then set its amount.
Ingredient was not added. Return to the recipe to review its size and ingredients.
Choose foods from your library. Each ingredient keeps the nutrition and serving you selected.
Check this amount, or remove and add the ingredient again.
Add at least one ingredient with compatible nutrient units and valid amounts.
This ingredient reports a nutrient in an incompatible unit. Choose another food with matching nutrient units.
Weigh the finished recipe if you want gram servings. Cooking can change its weight, so raw ingredient weights are not used as finished weight.
Enter a positive finished weight, or leave blank if unknown.
Add ingredients and enter valid amounts to calculate nutrition.
Unavailable means at least one ingredient did not report that nutrient.
Add a known finished weight to view nutrition per 100 g.
Check the recipe name, servings, and ingredient amounts before saving.
This recipe has too much stored detail. Use fewer ingredients or shorter text. Your last accepted changes are kept.
This recipe could not be opened. Try again, or return to your library.
